verification_note: a ground fact is a rule with an empty body list; solve(pred, args) returns a LIST of solutions, one per way the goal can be proven (real backtracking, not just first-match); an unbound variable (any arg starting uppercase) gets resolved via chained rule bodies -- grandparent(alice, Z) correctly resolves Z to carol via two chained parent facts; no matching rule/fact returns an empty list, not an error
